entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Project loading reports cancellation error on shutdown #84619
  • when i collapse an @if in a .razor file, i get the subsequent stuff in the same line #84617
  • Workspace APIs unusable on Blazor WebAssembly under .NET 11: AddProject takes a blocking SemaphoreSlim.Wait #84615
  • Support VB.NET in roslyn-language-server #84613
  • Razor cohost ImplementInterface inserts members mid-@code-block with decl/impl split #84609

Closed

  • Support VB.NET in roslyn-language-server #84612
  • EnC/Hot Reload: `GetPreviousMethodHandle` fails for a delta‑added source‑generated method on a later update (`MethodsAdded` tracking lost across generations) #84569
  • Hot Reload (EnC): NullReferenceException in `DefinitionMap.GetPreviousMethodHandle` deleting a delta-added source-generated method (MAUI XAML SourceGen `UpdateComponent`) #84560
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12023.122 #84610

PullRequests

Created

  • Reduce LSP request handling allocations #84623
    VSCode
  • Ensure we don't log errors when we are cancelling loading #84622
    VSCode
  • Consolidate ExternalAccess.Extensions into Features.ExternalAccess #84621
    Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: allow await in unsafe context #84616
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Update DiaSymReader.Converter package versions #84614
    VSCode
  • Don't throw exceptions for nested, prefixed, tag helpers #84611
    Area-Razor

Merged

  • Prevent diagnostic port inheritance by child processes #84620
    VSCode
  • Implement LSP daemon mode #84199
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Update nuget project model to STJ version #84618
  • Bump Microsoft.Build to 18.7.1 and mark ShowMessageForImplicitlySkipAnalyzers multithreadable #84343
    Community
  • Compiler: Guard EditorConfig section matching recursion #84606
  • Run Razor decl C# lowering before tag-helper discovery (classify-first component split) #84605
    Area-Razor

Updated

  • Allow MSBuildWorkspace to open file-based apps #84139
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Feature - Run File
  • Migrate MapSourceRoots task to multithreaded mode #84421
    Community
  • Do not report hidden pattern diagnostics #84576
  • Unsafe evolution: ensure diagnostics are picked up by IDE #84603
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Unsafe evolution: relax `safe` modifier placement restrictions #84602
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix IL3000: guard Assembly.Location access behind RuntimeFeature.IsDynamicCodeSupported #84599
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #84544
  • Fix duplicate `SyntaxNodeAction`s for union declarations and its members #84604
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #83901
    Area-Infrastructure, Needs API Review
  • Don't let a disconnected RPC client crash the BuildHost process #84412
    Community, VSCode
